manifest.name: Subsonic
manifest.author: Parachord Team
manifest.description: Stream from your own music server: Navidrome, Airsonic, Gonic or anything Subsonic-compatible.
manifest.requirement: Needs your own Subsonic-compatible server, such as Navidrome.

serverUrl.label: Server URL
serverUrl.description: Your server’s address, with its port.

password.label: Password
password.description: Your Subsonic account password. It's never sent in plain text.

reportPlays.label: Report plays to your server
reportPlays.hint: Shows what’s playing on your server and adds to its play counts. If it also scrobbles, a play may count twice.
